accessibility.description: Idol Showdown Access speaks menus, settings, character select, pop-ups, dialogue, tutorial tasks and victory texts through Windows SAPI voices or your screen reader. Character select announces the character, costume, collab partner and ready state. In fights, a stereo opponent locator gets faster as they near, with cues for airborne, adjacent and side switches, plus projectile warnings, a heartbeat at critical health and spoken round, score and result announcements. It works with a keyboard or an Xbox or PlayStation controller, follows the game's English or German language, and has its own mod menu. Chat and superchat overlays are not read.
